description:
Each tracked artifact in the twenty-three zen3 `dev/active/` entries listed below present at commit `7641561a9` receives one manifest row with ownership evidence, code consumers and a disposition, so regrouping and archival act only on defensible ownership.

## Background

Ownership is admissible only from an existing tracker document reference, an unambiguous issue identifier in the path or content, or unique `jit:<short-id>` commit provenance; an artifact without admissible evidence is unassociated and goes to `dev/archive/legacy/<original-relative-path>`. `dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/investigation.md` Appendix A gives the 2026-10-01 entry classification (rows whose top epic includes 1a379447) and the method used to derive it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The manifest holds one row per tracked file in the frozen entry list below (the twenty-three zen3 `dev/active/` entries listed below present at commit `7641561a9`), with owner or association evidence, owning top-level epic, bundle relationships and disposition.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every ownership claim cites an admissible evidence class; rows without admissible evidence carry the legacy-archive disposition.
- [hard] REQ-03: Entries shared by several epics record every owner and the destination chosen by the multi-owner rule.
- [hard] REQ-04: Each entry whose path a non-comment consumer reads or checks (production code, tests, scripts, measurement tooling, relative Cargo paths or configuration) is marked code-pinned and records every such consumer by file and line, and each digest-pinned machine input in the entry is marked.
- [hard] REQ-05: The progress checker reports the shard's rows schema-valid with every source assertion passing.

## Notes

Frozen entry list: `428f2f6b`, `4c1e441f`, `50f0bd42`, `53c5a8c0`, `5cbb6545`, `613574db`, `6c6b09b1`, `6fb89a3c`, `9f0e385e`, `a1ad6d4e`, `a203a23c`, `ad2a6a58`, `bc091474`, `bdc507a3`, `c04dd4ac-zen3-shifts-and-permutations`, `c077a88b`, `c7113c5a`, `c73ffa25`, `eda07788`, `f547c394`, `f63a2464`, `f8dd4dde`, `fcb04d66`. Entries created after commit `7641561a9` are outside this migration; the `@/inv/active-document-layout` invariant governs them at creation. The code-consumer scan (`dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/dev-path-code-consumers.md`) already identifies these entries as code-pinned: f547c394, eda07788, 5cbb6545, c7113c5a, 6fb89a3c, 53c5a8c0, 4c1e441f, 6c6b09b1, ad2a6a58, c077a88b and f63a2464.
